name: Push-up
description: Keep a straight body, lower your chest to just above the floor, and press back up.

name: Incline dumbbell press
description: Press dumbbells up from an incline bench, keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows.

name: Doorway chest stretch
description: Place your forearms on a doorframe and step through gently to feel the chest open.

name: Cable fly
description: Bring the cable handles together in front of your chest with a soft bend in the elbows.

name: Barbell bench press
description: Lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press it back up over your shoulders.
caution: Use a spotter for heavy sets. Keep feet planted and wrists stacked over elbows.

name: Dumbbell floor press
description: Lie on the floor and press dumbbells up, lowering until your upper arms touch the floor.

name: Wide-grip push-up
description: Place your hands wider than your shoulders and lower your chest with elbows flared slightly.

name: Chest dip
description: Lean forward on parallel bars, lower until you feel a stretch in the chest, then press up.
caution: Shoulder strain risk. Stop if you feel pinching at the front of the shoulder.

name: Pec deck fly
description: Sit tall and bring the pads together in front of your chest, squeezing at the center.

name: Band chest press
description: Press a band forward from chest height, extending your arms fully.
